content: Letz Nangi Sc Dzbe Lrmakxtr Kc Sadis

X Jiszs nzngini-krde ncblo kc tqapule Mrlx Leplz rpi-mople bange kx nayr-kzpo dq natq mz kxaclvele dzbe lrmakxtr kc mz taon Sadis. Rpibzle kx, “Krlcng natqnge, ninge kc tqrngine Mqngr ne Gct kc nzwz-krdeng rlimz x rngine kz vri kcng rlimz. Krlzpex nqmq krmu, nimu lr Sadis kx trtakitrkaple mz nzobqkr Gct rnge. Nzrpilr kx lubeamu, a' trtingr, murde bz-angidrpeamu. Dwalzmamu! Axplrtiamu nzlu-mqglq-krmu, murde ycpe pipz nzyrkrtxpx-krbzle.

Mzpu naobqpx zvz x natekqtramu nqmq ngr drtwrmu. Murde ma tqprkilvc-ngrnamu ninge nzapu-krnge ncblo kxpnada. Trnakrlzwamuu mzli kc navz-ngrmc. Bzkq mrbrtr mz drtwrmu da kcng tqmrlz tzpibz bamu x tqxlramu. X yrlq-angidramu natq lcng.
“A' nimu kxpipz mrkc Sadis kx lrpz scdr trblqkiu, sa nakqamu lrpz kxprki mzli kc navz-lxblr-ngrgu murde takitrde nimu.

“Mrlx kx aovxiole nzvec-krdr badr zmatqng kxtrka, sa nakq lrpz kxprki na-apule lr Sadis lcdeng, x trnakapxpwc'u drtqde mz Buk ngr Nzlungr. A' napipxbo mz Trtenge x enjrl nedeng kx ni-angidrde doa nenge.
“Abzamu nzyrlq-angidr-krmu natq lcng tqpibz Mqngrkxtr mz mz dzbe lrmakxtr lcng.” Delape. Ninge Jiszs.
Letz Nangi Sc Dzbe Lrmakxtr Kc Filadelfia

X ncblo kc tqapule Mrlx Leplz rpi-mople bange kx nayr-kzpo dq natq mz kxaclvele dzbe lrmakxtr kc mz taon Filadelfia. Rpibzle kx, “Krlcng natqnge, ninge kc tqtr-esz'ngr x tqngi da angidr. Lolvzx ki sc King Devet, kc drtwr ngrde kx rngiscnge zmatq ngr nzrlvxngr naonrx kx trpnzngr kx rkrlz nzrbqngr, x zmatq ngr nzrbqngr naonrx kx trpnzngr kx rkrlz nzrlvxngr.

Krlzpex nqmq krmu, nimu lr Filadelfia. Kxmule-esz' trnipwamuu kxnzetung, a' yrlq-angidramu natqnge x trtxpnzngr nzrpi-krmu kx trkrlzwamuu ninge. Delc, naonrx se tqlvxpxbo bamu, naonrx kx trpnzngr kx rkrlz nzrbqtrngr.
“Lalztqmamu bange. Dzbe leplz kcng tzangiolr Setzn tzrpilr nidr lr Jiu, a' nzpokia-ngrdr. Sa navzmimc nidr mz nzavzo-lzbq-krbzlr bamu, murde nakrlzlr kx mrlzti-zlwzx nimu.
X sa na-arlapxbo nimu mz da kcng tqtrka naprtzbz mz leplz amrlx mz nrlc mz nzayrplapxngr nidr, murde mz nzyrlq-angidr-krmu natqnge, tu-amqngi-zvzamu kxmule-esz' nzaetqbz drtqmu.
Mzli trnzboi-krdeu x sa nayzlupe-mopwc'. Lolvz-amqngiamu nzlxngiti-krmu ninge murde ma tzangqngutilr, x sc tr-rtwzpewamuu da kxmrlz mz nzaovxio-krmu mz nzvecngr.

“Murde mrlx kx aovxio mz nzvec-krdr badr zmatqng kxtrka, nide kx navzmibo mz Gct rnge na-apule nctrpou ngr Mangr-nzangiongr kxmrna, x trtxpengr nzdwasz-krdele. X nayrtrpo bade drtq kxmrna lcde seng tq. Drtq kx ayrnrngr drtq mzteadau nyz Gct, Jerusalem kxmrna kc tqvzom Heven. Murde Jerusalem kxmrna nangi mrnyzde. X drtq krali drtq Gct rnge, murde nide doa ne Gct. X drtq kratq drtqnge kxmrna, murde ni-kzde doa nenge.
“Abzamu nzyrlq-angidr-krmu natq lcng tqpibz Mqngrkxtr mz mz dzbe lrmakxtr lcng.” Delape. Ninge Jiszs.
Letz Nangi Sc Dzbe Lrmakxtr Kc Laodisea

X Jiszs nzngini-krde ncblo kc tqapule Mrlx Leplz rpi-mople bange kx nayr-kzpo dq natq mz kxaclvele dzbe lrmakxtr kc mz taon Laodisea. Natq lc nide sele. “Krlcng natqnge, ninge kc tqapux natq lc tqngi ‘angida’ murde ninge kc tqrngi-batrpz da amrlx mz nzvz-nqblq-krde me pnz drtwr Gct. X ni-kznge ncblo angidr kc tqrpipx-angidrpe natqdeng. X ninge nou da amrlx kcng tqwzngr Gct.
Krlzpex nqmq krmu. Krlzx kx trvz-nqblqwamuu ninge mz drtwr kxpq o drtwr kxbao. A' na-aoti drtwrmu me navz-nqblqkiamule, murde drtwrmu napqtrpz o nabaotrpz. Bzkq drtwrmu li.
A' mz nzngini-krmu ncte lxblr mz da amrlx x pq-lrpiamu, sa nabyapx-ngrne nimu na-apule lue kxtrka.

“Rpiamu kx nimu bcnyrng, x rngiscpemu da amrlx kcng tqsuti drtwrmu. A' trkrlzwamuu kx mz nrlarde nyz mqngrmu x nabzmu tatxpxamu mz da amrlx mzli ka. Mz nzobqkr Gct, nimu leplz kxdrka'ngr, kxnzyc mz drtwr, kxtrnzrngiscung, kx mzpu mwi x ycblqamu.

Rlr-ngrmamu bange nzka-krbo bamu da kx na-atubqtile nimu mz nzobqkr Gct. Rlr-ngrmamu bange nzxpe-krbo alwx ngrmu mz nzbz-krnge, na-apule kx xpeamu gol. Delc nanginimu bcnyr angidr mz nzrmcti-krmu nzlungr kxboi. X apxitr-lzbq-ngrnamu lrpznge kxprki ngr nztubq-esz'ngr-krnge, murde drtqmu ma tqmya mzli kc navz-ngrmc. Murde mzli lc naoliqti-angidramu ninge. X rlr-ngrmamu bange nzaelwa-lzbq-krbo bamu, murde nakrlz-angidramu ninge na-apule luekxpiz kx ngi tolo kx nakitramu mz mzpu mz nzobq-angidr-krmu.
Krkcng tqmrlzti-zlwzxng krlzx nzlclvz-krbo badr da, x nzayrplapxngr nidr. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, drtwrmu nayzlu, x napqtitr drtwrmu ninge.
Murde ninge la tqtutrp yz mz naonrx nyzmu, tqabctrpo mz nzaenzli-krnge nzvzmitr-krmu ninge. Doa kx xlrle natqnge x lvxpxmle naonrx bange, sa nadwatrpo ma nyzde mz nzmu-lxblr-krgr ncdr.

“Mrlx kx aovxio mz nzvec-krdr badr zmatqng kxtrka, sa na-awxbuox nide mz tron mz nzwxbu-krgr badr mz nzaclvengr. Da kc tqwaix mz nzaovxio-krnge mz nzvec-krgr badr zmatqng kxtrka, x wxbupekr ncdr Trtenge mz nzaclvengr.
“Abzamu nzyrlq-angidr-krmu natq lcng tqpibz Mqngrkxtr mz mz dzbe lrmakxtr lcng.” Delape. Ninge Jiszs.
